`three.min.js` is three.js r128 (MIT License, Copyright 2010-2021 Three.js Authors), unmodified from
https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js. It draws the 3D stage. The page falls back to
that CDN copy if this file is missing, and to the 2D painting if WebGL is not available.
